<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:UI-030-important-20261029 -->
Implemented and verified; closing immediately after reviewing **all three original criteria**, authoritative-state/gesture source, actual fresh results and unchanged earlier acceptance methods.

[Immutable UIKit run40787364174](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40787364174) at `85d6d83b973bc36f0800ff231d6f97a16a3df08c` **SUCCESS**: **3/3** fresh genuine Compose/UIKit methods, one XML, zero failures/errors/skips, Gradle **0/1632.85s**. All820 before/after inputs match their own Git revision; actual JDK17, iPhone iOS26.5/Xcode26.6, source/runtime/XML/protocol, distinct main/generated Worker completion and owned app cleanup reviewed.

- Delayed owner: proposed checked value does not become library-owned state. Measured thumb and authoritative Off semantics restore before acceptance; applying the delayed update moves exactly the20dp drag distance and On semantics, without another callback.
- Actual thumb and both track ends each propose once. Measured live preview crosses the threshold without changing owner/semantics; return then release emits no toggle and restores the measured thumb.
- Disabled tap/drag leave thumb, Disabled/On semantics and zero-callback state unchanged.
- Four unchanged original actual UIKit acceptance methods from40522929974 attempt2/20205909 cover null callback, accepting/rejecting owner and external checked/disabled update mid-gesture. Exact method bodies, four owning production files and catalog match; these successful methods were **reused, not replayed**. **3fresh+4reused=7 accepted executions.**

Repair separates transient drag preview from authoritative checked state, reconciles after every outcome and attaches full-control toggle semantics/gestures. Public APIs/packages/native names remain. [Evidence](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/tree/development/preview-hardening/docs/development/evidence/switch-ownership-important-20261028) preserves local KLIB-only results and prior failures. The reports-only offline review does not pretend to rerun the producer's absent executable/MachO/mtime checks; retained live bindings and independent XML/protocol/runtime/cleanup are explicitly distinguished.

Simulator pointer injection is not physical hardware, VoiceOver/Switch Control or older/minimum-OS/heap/profiling/ABI/consumer/dependency/legal/security/release certification. Those independent gates remain open. No package/release/deployment or unrelated full-suite replay.

<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:NATIVE-002-important-20261029 -->
Implemented and verified; closing directly after review against **all three original Android/Desktop lifecycle criteria**.

Two actual owning causes were fixed: a disposed native view persisted through predecessor Compose snapshot records, then the Android interop holder remained reachable through Compose's cached LayoutNode children. Current native handles now live outside snapshot history; AndroidView now owns a lightweight detachable FrameLayout, not the native WebView. Release severs its native field/child, saves the matching native state, stops/detaches/destroys and clears only that owner. Throwing application/native cleanup preserves the first failure and attempts remaining stages. No reflection, accessibility-listener/cache mutation, renderer stub or weakened collection assertion.

**Current immutable Android [40808466133](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40808466133)** at `b3831693d968d6cd8ef80ba2729a000cca0374a6`: **3/3**, one fresh XML, no failures/errors/skips, Gradle **0/70.03s**, all **831** own-Git inputs held, actual JDK17/Enforcing API35 and clean unforced owned emulator shutdown. Repeated real Activity/native collection + public Saver/Parcel/native-history restoration pass. Composition-only unmount now collects the previously-playing native view while its Activity stays **RESUMED**, closes the real slow connection and stops timer/network work; native content still fills actual Compose-owned bounds. Throwing release preserves a distinct live native replacement.

**20 accepted desktop target executions reused, not replayed:** Linux x64, Windows x64 and macOS arm64 **5/5 each**, plus four original Intel positives from [40800212182](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40800212182); the failed Intel media method alone was recovered **1/1 / 0/443.29s** in [40804208284](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40804208284). Actual Compose/JavaFX/WebKit mounts, weak collection, decoded/clocked media/slow-request shutdown, second-window safety after throwing disposal, queued initialization cancellation and native URL/history/save contracts are exercised. Desktop/common/build production bytes are unchanged; only reinforcing media diagnostics were added. Original failed matrix and failed real ART heap run remain failures in the archive.

**23 native target executions** (eight authored native methods across hosts), plus **3/3 fresh owning-container Android-host regressions** for retained holders, creation failure and throwing cleanup/replacement; host Gradle **0/56.01s** and real test APK assembly pass. Android WebViewState public JVM descriptors/native public references/callback signatures remain; the private native parent hierarchy gains a FrameLayout.

[Reviewed evidence](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/tree/development/preview-hardening/docs/development/evidence/webview-lifetime-important-20261029) preserves exact source/results and privacy boundaries; raw heaps/parser/APKs are never uploaded. Only necessary changed Android tests reran; unchanged desktop successes were retained.

These checks do not certify Apple WKWebView, audible/physical/minimum-device behavior, OS process death, sustained native allocation/sanitizer, accessibility/IME/custom-animation, full API/ABI/consumer/dependency/provenance/legal/security or release gates. Those independent requirements remain open. Original issue body/title/labels/history remain intact. No packages, releases, deployment or Pages.

Three real no-parent GTK scenarios verify immediate public launch/repeated exact file selections, host close while visible and safe registry close during a live show. Three actual Compose + JNI scheduling/configuration scenarios count handoff allocation/close and snapshot limits/Java parents/latest callbacks. The real private FileChooser v3 and all three owned services shut down cleanly; no mock chooser/user bus.

macOS arm64 current **3/3** portable Compose/JNI methods (**0/314.72s**) and unchanged Windows x64 [40815285475](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40815285475) **3/3** (**0/296.61s**) also pass; each has three explicit Linux-only N/A cases, not six passes. **12 accepted target executions of six authored methods**, not a fresh whole library suite. Seven unchanged real coroutine/JNI handoff methods at `97effbd7` and eight unchanged actual native configuration/registry/encoding methods under Valgrind at `53e56c7e` are reused, not rerun: zero invalid-access/definite/indirect loss, preserved **48 possible/544 reachable bytes** in std/libtest. Native production payload hash still matches `97effbd7` exactly.

The original failed missing-renderer run and Linux PID/name-OR lookup failures remain failures; test-only actual renderer dependency and exact PID **AND** title lookup fix those fixture roots. macOS selected-path fixtures still fail before JNI because its filesystem rejects invalid UTF-8 names (EILSEQ92); that separate CI fixture is being repaired, not a passing matrix. This does not invalidate these executed ownership methods.

[Persistent reviewed evidence](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/tree/development/preview-hardening/docs/development/evidence/picker-batch-important-20261029) records source/results, failed diagnostics and additive acceptance/readbacks. **IO-023/#58 native parenting/thread/Wayland remains open**; Java parent snapshots do not certify native parents, and iOS representation/Android fallback/saver requirements keep #53/#54 open. Full physical/minimum-platform/native allocator/ABI/consumer/dependency/provenance/legal/security/release gates and the macOS fixture CI recovery remain restricted. Original technical body/title/labels/history preserved; no packages, releases, deployments or Pages.

## Resolved in related file metadata / iOS filter batch

Reviewed every original criterion against the owning source and actual completed tests. Public packages/descriptors, original issue text/labels and upstream history remain unchanged.

Seven unchanged actual native path/name methods reused.

URI restoration points to the deleted original, not a fictitious copy. This proves local original unavailability, not cloud grant expiry or OS purging; those remain IO-008/IO-013/IO-019 gates.
- **Android content:// vs file://:** Fresh Android-host five actual Robolectric Uri cases distinguish content null filesystem path from decoded file path and URI/plain-path restoration. External grants and cross-process provider lifetime are not claimed.
- **Two browser files with identical names:** Fresh real Chrome JS and Wasm File/FileReader test uses identical Unicode/percent names with distinct bytes, concurrent/repeated reads, truthful null path/URI/restoration and overload parity. Older extensionless-name test was not duplicate-name evidence.
- **Round-trip URI serialization independent of path:** Fresh desktop URI round-trip and Android-host restoration plus fresh native original/copy distinction; three unchanged real native URI restoration and two non-file/local-path isolation methods reused. getPath semantic migration and toUriString are explicit in IO.md.

The browser/URI eight executed with851 held inputs before committing, then all851 exactly matched this immutable source without replay; earlier filter two retain849/850 exact binding because one separately red→green Python upload guard changed afterward.

**Do not read this as a green native workflow:** 26 selected native methods yielded22 passing +2 assertion failures +1 interrupted Unknown XML failure; one host method has no XML. All four filter/three copy-boundary methods have complete native TeamCity frames matching fresh XML and closed owning suites before the separate host interruption. Actual app activation/main-versus-owned Worker and two calibration methods passed; owned app stop/uninstall/local cleanup was read back. Complete Worker termination/binary-after/runtime-after gates failed/unavailable and are NOT waived. Unrelated UIKit presentation/host failures stay open and will receive failed-only recovery.

Twelve unchanged actual native path/URI/non-file-isolation methods from successful40587910531/fc73dd47 are explicitly reused, not rerun; the only IO build change is webMain browser implementation→api, not a native dependency change. **Migration:** use `toUriString()` for URI serialization; `getPath()` means an optional readable filesystem path. Restoring a reference does not restore access.

Cloud/NSItemProvider cancellation, interactive swipe/export destination, native parent leases/platform caps, physical/minimum-device, full packaged-consumer/API-ABI, dependency/provenance/notices/security/release requirements remain open.
